rows.name: Short-form
rows.what: The punchy one. Scroll-stopper, one idea, out.

extra.form: A few short sentences. Hard first line. No wind-up, no build.
extra.opens_with: the sharpest single line the argument contains
extra.reads_as: someone saying one true thing and stopping

rows.name: Caption / Meta primary text
rows.what: The words above the creative in the feed.

extra.form: Real sentences. First line stands alone, then short paragraphs, one idea each, blank line between.
extra.opens_with: a line that works with the creative not yet seen
extra.reads_as: something a person typed, not something a brand approved

rows.name: Long-form story
rows.what: A story that earns its length — the middle included, not skipped.

extra.form: Paragraphs. Full prose. A reader who stops for it finishes it.
extra.opens_with: a promise the length will be worth it
extra.reads_as: a post someone wrote because they wanted to

rows.name: Social proof
rows.what: Built on other people's words — what customers actually said.

extra.form: Quotes on their own lines, connective sentences between them.
extra.opens_with: the strongest quote, or the claim the quotes will settle
